description: A brand's identity as its own website shows it: logo (SVG or image URL, with the ground it sits on), colors (signature, page, ink, palette), typefaces, tone of voice, and its full theme as CSS custom properties. Works for any website: one nobody has read yet is read on the spot (about a minute). Use it to build anything on-brand.
name: get_brand

colors.description: brand (signature), page, ink and palette, as hex.

logo.description: SVG markup or image URL, with the ground it sits on.

variables.description: The full theme as CSS custom properties.

voice.description: Tone of voice traits, each between two poles.

title: Get a brand
